simplemachines.guide.page.1.title: Simple Machines
simplemachines.guide.page.1: The machine parts of the Simple Machines tab: the Double Piston, which reaches further than any Vanilla piston, and the Signal Dampener, a repeater that takes up to 3 off the signal.
simplemachines.guide.page.2.title: Double Piston
simplemachines.guide.page.2: One block that pushes in two stages: a signal of 1 to 7 brings the head out one block like a Vanilla piston, 8 to 15 moves the body half a block forward and the head a second block - three blocks long in all.
simplemachines.guide.page.3.title: Signal Dampener
simplemachines.guide.page.3: A flat redstone part like the Repeater that takes 0 to 3 off the signal and passes it on one redstone tick later.
simplemachines.guide.page.4.title: Creative tabs
simplemachines.guide.page.4: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplemachines.guide.page.5.title: Commands
simplemachines.guide.page.6.title: Settings
simplemachines.guide.page.6: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simplemachines.start.title: Welcome to Simple Machines
quests.simplemachines.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simplemachines.start.welcome.desc: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Machines Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and redstone dust.
